description: Stations de recharge pour véhicule électrique - Département de l'Eure is a dataset listed in Roumoiseine open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Huwise. Ce jeu de données géolocalise les bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques (IRVE) dans le Département de l'Eure. Les champs de ce jeu de données respectent le schéma des bornes de recharge du référentiel des données publiques de schema.data.gouv.fr. Il peut être considéré comme complémentaire du dataset IRVE. Il se base sur les données OpenStreetMap. Coverage: Roumois Seine (Eure). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are openstreetmap, borne, voiture, recharge, véhicule électrique. The portal shows 176 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-04-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-roumoiseine-fr-portal.
